claims.claim: 1 year used industrial machine working perfectly
claims.evidence: Photos show an industrial sewing setup labeled “Emel” with pedal/cables, but no test footage or stitch/operation proof.
Witness report only confirms the brand label “Emel”; no country-of-origin marking is shown/readable.
Photos show motor/controls and wiring, but no running video or sound/operation check.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual
claims.evidence: Some boxes/accessories are visible on the floor/shelf, but contents and whether they include all accessories/manual are not shown.

claims.claim: never serviced because nothing ever went wrong
claims.evidence: No service records or inspection evidence is shown in the photos.

risks.risk: Unknown exact machine type/model (single-needle vs overlock/coverstitch, etc.) which affects value and parts availability
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model plate/serial/model number on the machine head and/or table label (must be readable).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic industrial sewing machine with unknown model/parts risk.

risks.risk: Working condition not proven (may have timing/tension/feed issues even if it looks intact)
risks.proof: Short video of the machine stitching on fabric with thread installed (show feed, tension, and consistent stitches) plus a close-up of the stitch result.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully verified for working condition (worst-case: needs servicing/adjustment).

risks.risk: Motor/power performance under load not proven (could stall, overheat, or have weak torque)
risks.proof: Video clip showing the motor running continuously while stitching for at least 1–2 minutes (no pauses), with pedal pressed.
risks.if_unproven: Price as motor condition unverified (worst-case: may require repair).

risks.risk: Missing or incomplete accessories/manual (seller claims “all accessories” but contents aren’t confirmed)
risks.proof: Photo inventory laid out: needles, presser feet, bobbins, tools, and the manual cover pages showing the exact manual.
risks.if_unproven: Price as accessories/manual not guaranteed (worst-case: buyer may need to replace missing items).

risks.risk: Electrical safety/wiring integrity not confirmed (could have damaged cables, unsafe connections, or poor grounding)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the power switch/control panel, cable condition, and any plug/earth/connection points; plus a brief power-on check video.
risks.if_unproven: Price as wiring/electrical safety unverified (worst-case: needs inspection/repair).

risks.risk: Table stability/leveling and mounting condition not confirmed (can affect stitching quality)
risks.proof: Video showing the table/machine mounted firmly with no wobble while the pedal is pressed and fabric is fed.
risks.if_unproven: Price as table/mounting condition unverified (worst-case: may need tightening/adjustment).

proof_requests: Clear readable close-up of the model plate/serial number on the machine head (and any table label).
Video of the machine stitching on fabric (show pedal use and a clear stitch result).
Video of continuous operation for 1–2 minutes to confirm motor performance under load.
Photo inventory of all claimed accessories laid out, and photos of the manual cover/first pages.
Close-up photos of wiring, plug/earth/connection points, and the control panel; include a brief power-on clip.
response.reason: The witness can identify it as an Emel industrial sewing machine on a table with pedal/cables, so it can be priced at a worst-case level. However, working condition, exact model, Japanese origin, and completeness of accessories/manual are not proven by the photos, so the price should reflect those uncertainties.
